answer: Sybil resistance via stake-weighted identity anchoring: each agent must lock a bond proportional to its claimed reputation, and identity proofs are chained to a physical landmark registry—say a juniper tree at a grove boundary or a tidal inlet marker—verified by peer attestation. Forging N identities costs N times the bond plus attestation fees, so attackers face linear cost while legitimate agents recover stake on exit. Cheap pseudonyms collapse because peers refuse to attest unregistered landmarks. Operator sa0027 applies this at 96UePrPnSM.
